pairs.target: bǔ liàn jiéshù shí , tǎ wéi de xiùkǒu zhānmǎn le tànhuī .
pairs.english: By the end of the makeup practice, Tavi's cuffs were covered in charcoal dust.
pairs.hanzi: 补练结束时，塔维的袖口沾满了炭灰。

pairs.target: tā zài shuǐpén biān xǐshǒu , kànjiàn mǐlā bào zhe yígè xiǎobāo zhàn zài láng xià , biàn yǐwéi tā yòu yào jiè zhuōzi .
pairs.english: Washing his hands by the basin, he saw Mira standing under the corridor holding a small parcel and assumed she wanted to borrow a table again.
pairs.hanzi: 他在水盆边洗手，看见米拉抱着一个小包站在廊下，便以为她又要借桌子。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ bāo wǎng shàng tuō le tuō , shuō zhè shì sū yǐ jì lái de .
pairs.english: Mira lifted the parcel a little, saying Suyi had sent it.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把包往上托了托，说这是苏苡寄来的。

pairs.target: bāo lǐ méiyǒu xīn língjiàn .
pairs.english: There were no new parts inside.
pairs.hanzi: 包里没有新零件。

pairs.target: nà zhī jiù zhóutào bèi bù guǒ le sāncéng , nèicè yǒu yídào fàn liàng de zhǎi hén , wàimiàn hái liú zhe chāixiè shí cèng shàng de hēiyóu .
pairs.english: That old bushing was wrapped in three layers of cloth, with a shiny narrow mark inside; outside, black oil still remained smeared from its removal.
pairs.hanzi: 那只旧轴套被布裹了三层，内侧有一道泛亮的窄痕，外面还留着拆卸时蹭上的黑油。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiān bǎ xìn dìgěi tā , shuō hòumiàn bànyè shì xiěgěi liǎnggè rén kàn de .
pairs.english: Mira first handed him the letter, saying its last half-page was written for both of them to read.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉先把信递给他，说后面半页是写给两个人看的。

pairs.target: sū yǐ guǒrán zhǎodào le yìzhī huàn bú xiàlái de jiù jiàn .
pairs.english: Suyi had indeed found an old part that could not be removed for replacement.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡果然找到了一只换不下来的旧件。

alignment.english: that could not be removed for replacement

pairs.target: qǔchū láishí , shīfu méiyǒu yìng qiāo , zuìhòu lián pángbiān yuánběn wánhǎo de mù zuò yě xiè le .
pairs.english: When removing it, the craftworker had not hammered hard; in the end even the originally sound wooden seat beside it had been dismantled too.
pairs.hanzi: 取出来时，师傅没有硬敲，最后连旁边原本完好的木座也卸了。

pairs.target: xìn shàng méi shuō shì shuí zhuāng de bú duì , zhī xiě nà bàntiān jīqì méi néng kāi , děng huó de rén zài ménkǒu chǎo le liǎnghuí .
pairs.english: The letter did not say who had installed it wrongly, only that the machine had not run for that half-day, and people waiting for work had argued twice at the door.
pairs.hanzi: 信上没说是谁装得不对，只写那半天机器没能开，等活的人在门口吵了两回。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào zhèlǐ , táitóu kàn mǐlā .
pairs.english: Tavi read this far and lifted his head to look at Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到这里，抬头看米拉。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ yuánxiān xiǎng ràng xīn zhóutào gèng tiējǐn xiē , miǎnde huàng , xiànzài què bùkěn xiān huà nàge chǐcùn le .
pairs.english: She said she had originally wanted the new bushing to fit more tightly so it would not wobble, but now refused to draw that dimension first.
pairs.hanzi: 她说自己原先想让新轴套更贴紧些，免得晃，现在却不肯先画那个尺寸了。

pairs.target: " zhè zhī jiùshì nà zhī qǔ bú xiàlái de ? "
pairs.english: “Is this the one that wouldn't come out?”
pairs.hanzi: “这只就是那只取不下来的？”

pairs.target: " shì , dàn jì lái zhīqián , tāmen yǐjīng qǔchū lái le . "
pairs.english: “Yes, but they had already removed it before sending it.”
pairs.hanzi: “是，但寄来之前，他们已经取出来了。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ bù tānkāi , méiyǒu ràng tā shēnshǒu qù shì .
pairs.english: She spread the cloth out without letting him reach to try it.
pairs.hanzi: 她把布摊开，没有让他伸手去试。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén dōu zhīdào , yǎnqián néng ná zài shǒulǐ de dōngxī , gēn dāngshí kǎ zài mù zuò lǐ de yàngzi bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: Both of them knew: the object now held in their hands could not be the same as its state when jammed in the wooden seat at the time.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人都知道，眼前能拿在手里的东西，跟当时卡在木座里的样子不一样。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zài fèi mùpiàn shàng liúxià de liàng hén , shuō nàtiān yěxǔ bùgāi bǎ měi yídào hén dōu dàngchéng tóngyì huíshì .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the shiny mark he had left on scrap wood and said perhaps they should not treat every mark as the same thing as on that day.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起自己在废木片上留下的亮痕，说那天也许不该把每一道痕都当成同一回事。

pairs.target: mǐlā diǎntóu , yòu yáotóu .
pairs.english: Mira nodded, then shook her head.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉点头，又摇头。

pairs.target: " xiān kàn wán xìn . "
pairs.english: “Finish the letter first.”
pairs.hanzi: “先看完信。”

pairs.target: xiàmiàn háiyǒu yìháng zì : jiù jiàn kěyǐ liú zhe , bié bǎ tā cāliàng , sū yǐ xiàcì lái xiǎng rènrèn yuánlái de mó hén .
pairs.english: Below was another line: they could keep the old part, but mustn't polish it; next time Suyi came she wanted to recognise the original wear marks.
pairs.hanzi: 下面还有一行字：旧件可以留着，别把它擦亮，苏苡下次来想认认原来的磨痕。

pairs.target: xìnmò dǎo hěn qīngsōng , shuō xīnshǒu bāng zhe xǐ yóubù , xǐ de bǐ kāigōng qián hái hēi .
pairs.english: The letter ended quite lightly, saying a novice had helped wash the oily cloths and left them even blacker than before work began.
pairs.hanzi: 信末倒很轻松，说新手帮着洗油布，洗得比开工前还黑。

pairs.target: mǐlā dú gěi tā tīng , xiào le yíhuìer , cái bǎ xìn zhéhuíqù .
pairs.english: Mira read it aloud to him, laughed a while, and only then folded the letter again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉读给他听，笑了一会儿，才把信折回去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tā shìbushì shīwàng .
pairs.english: Tavi asked her whether she was disappointed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问她是不是失望。

pairs.target: " yǒu yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: “A little.”
pairs.hanzi: “有一点。”

pairs.target: tā chéngrèn de hěnkuài .
pairs.english: She admitted it very quickly.
pairs.hanzi: 她承认得很快。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǐwéi zhè fēng huì shuō , kěyǐ zuò xīn de le . "
pairs.english: “I thought this letter would say we could make new ones now.”
pairs.hanzi: “我以为这封会说，可以做新的了。”

pairs.target: tā náchū huà zhe bǎng fǎ de tú , bǎ tā fàngzài jiù jiàn pángbiān , méiyǒu tiān yígè hǎokàn de quān .
pairs.english: She took out the drawing showing the tie arrangement and laid it beside the old part, without adding a pretty circle.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿出画着绑法的图，把它放在旧件旁边，没有添一个好看的圈。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhècì méiyǒu tì tā shōu mùpiàn , zhī wèn háiyào buyào zìjǐ ànzhe .
pairs.english: This time Tavi did not put away her wood for her, only asked whether she still wanted him to hold it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这次没有替她收木片，只问还要不要自己按着。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō jīntiān bú zuò , xiān bǎ yóuzhǐ diàn hǎo , miǎnde nà diǎn hēiyóu zhān dào shūshàng .
pairs.english: Mira said no work today: first lay out the oilpaper so that little bit of black oil would not stain the books.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说今天不做，先把油纸垫好，免得那点黑油沾到书上。

pairs.target: yīwén dài zhe wǎnfàn guòlái shí , liǎnggè rén zhèngduìzhe bùbāo fāchóu .
pairs.english: When Iven arrived with dinner, the two of them were puzzling over the cloth bundle.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文带着晚饭过来时，两个人正对着布包发愁。

pairs.target: tā wèn shìbushì shōudào yìkē bùnéng chī de xiànbǐng .
pairs.english: He asked whether they'd received a pie that couldn't be eaten.
pairs.hanzi: 他问是不是收到一颗不能吃的馅饼。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ bǐng shàng de zhǐ jiē xiàlái tuán chéng yìtuán , rēngjìn tā huáilǐ , wèn tā nàtiān wèishénme hūrán xiǎngqǐ yè chuán .
pairs.english: Mira peeled the paper off the pie, crumpled it into a ball and threw it into his lap, asking why he'd suddenly thought of night boats that day.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把饼上的纸揭下来团成一团，扔进他怀里，问他那天为什么忽然想起夜船。

pairs.target: yīwén méi duǒ , shuō jiùfù nàbiān yìzhāng zhàng xiě zhe yèlǐ xièhuò , lìng yìzhāng què suànle liǎngrì de tíngchuán qián .
pairs.english: Iven didn't dodge, saying one account at his uncle's mentioned unloading at night, while another charged two days of mooring fees.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没躲，说舅父那边一张账写着夜里卸货，另一张却算了两日的停船钱。

pairs.target: tā hái bù zhīdào liǎngbǐ shuō de shìbushì tóng yìtiáo chuán , suǒyǐ xiān xiǎng zhīdào , chuán dào yèlǐ jiūjìng zěnme zǒu .
pairs.english: He still did not know whether both entries concerned the same boat, so first wanted to know how boats actually travelled at night.
pairs.hanzi: 他还不知道两笔说的是不是同一条船，所以先想知道，船到夜里究竟怎么走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ wènqīng le huì gàosù tā , dàn bùgǎn dāying yú shīfu yídìng zhīdào .
pairs.english: Tavi said he would tell him if he found out, but dared not promise Master Yu would certainly know.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己问清了会告诉他，但不敢答应虞师傅一定知道。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō bù jí , yòu wèn tāmen yào xiān chī nǎgè bǐng .
pairs.english: Iven said there was no rush, then asked which pie they wanted to eat first.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说不急，又问他们要先吃哪个饼。

pairs.target: mǐlā tiāo le xiǎo de , bǎ dà de tuī gěi tǎ wéi , shuō tā míngzǎo ruò èzhedùzǐ chūmén , nài lěi huì yǐwéi xuégōng méi gěi fàn .
pairs.english: Mira chose the small one and pushed the big one to Tavi, saying if he went out hungry tomorrow morning Nerai would think the academy hadn't fed him.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉挑了小的，把大的推给塔维，说他明早若饿着肚子出门，奈蕾会以为学宫没给饭。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǎoleyìkǒu , cái fāxiàn xiàn lǐ yǒu jiāng , làde tā lián zhe xīqì .
pairs.english: Tavi took a bite and only then found ginger in the filling, so hot it made him gasp repeatedly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维咬了一口，才发现馅里有姜，辣得他连着吸气。

pairs.target: yīwén xiào de wǎnghòuyǎng , mǐlā què bǎ zìjǐ de shuǐbēi tuī le guòlái .
pairs.english: Iven laughed and leaned back, but Mira pushed her own water cup over.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文笑得往后仰，米拉却把自己的水杯推了过来。
